about_short_description.short_description: Waza is a B2B payments platform and liquidity provider for emerging market businesses.

product.name: Multi-Currency Payments
product.description: Enables businesses in emerging markets to send and receive payments in USD, EUR, and GBP with 24/7 access to foreign currency.

product.name: Payment Channels
product.description: Offers multiple payment options including Waza balance, debit cards, e-wallets, and bank transfers for global payments.

product.name: Dashboard and Reporting
product.description: Provides an easy-to-use dashboard with reporting and reconciliation features for managing payments and cross-border invoices.

product.name: Customizable Invoicing
product.description: Allows businesses to create invoices customized to their brand and supports multi-currency billing.

product.name: Invoice Financing (Beta)
product.description: Provides working capital by financing unpaid invoices to improve cash flow for businesses.

product.name: Local Currency Payments
product.description: Enables businesses to pay in their local currency to simplify cross-border transactions and avoid currency exchange issues.
